adjudication.depicted_input: Figure 1 directly depicts the Cell2Text input path: single-cell RNA-seq profiles are encoded into gene embeddings, adapted/projected, and concatenated with instruction and prompt embeddings before entering the language model decoder during fine-tuning.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop is defensible for both listed actual_model_input routes. It visibly shows the source object (single-cell RNA-seq profile), the transformation chain (cell encoder to gene embeddings to modality adapter/projected embeddings), and the immediate interface where instruction embeddings, gene embeddings, and prompt embeddings feed the language model decoder. Under the atlas rules, a shared architecture figure can support named variants from the same paper when the depicted input mechanism is the same, so lack of a visible Gemma-4B-specific label is not disqualifying. Other candidate figures are dataset or analysis plots and do not show an input path.
